description: This file defines the SslAcceleratorValve class, which extends ValveBase and is used to set the secure flag on requests based on a configured SSL accelerator port. It is integrated into a Tomcat/Catalina server configuration for handling SSL acceleration.

classes.name: SslAcceleratorValve
classes.description: A valve component for Tomcat server to mark requests as secure if they arrive on a specified SSL accelerator port.

methods.name: setSslAcceleratorPort
methods.description: Sets the SSL accelerator port for the valve.

methods.name: getSslAcceleratorPort
methods.description: Returns the configured SSL accelerator port.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Checks if the request's local port matches the SSL accelerator port and marks it as secure if so, then proceeds to the next valve.
